facts.text: I want to use evidence to check whether a given sentence is correct.
I want the evidence to be summarized and noisy or irrelevant information to be filtered out.
I want the answer to be a list.
I do not need to choose the evidence.
I want a list of useful information.
I want to summarize useful information and also do reasoning with the evidence.
I want to edit wrong information in the evidence.
I want to filter irrelevant information in the evidence.
I want reasoning, filtering, and summarizing to be done simultaneously.
I want the output to be only a list.
I asked to polish my instruction that describes using evidence to check if a sentence is correct.
I want the conclusion to be one of SUPPORTS, REFUTES, or NOT ENOUGH INFORMATION.
I want the conclusion to be chosen because the evidence may not contain enough information to determine whether the sentence is correct.
I want the information list to start with the relevant title from the original evidence.

keyphrases: conclusion labels SUPPORTS REFUTES NOT ENOUGH INFORMATION
